integrity: The general proof and coefficient recurrence are self-contained. Embedded finite checker uses the Python standard library, and its output is included. No independent audit or formal certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No exhaustive historical-priority review or independent science validation; full proof applies to oriented simple graphs only (not parallel arcs with opposite directions); computed checks through n=6 and all oriented simple graphs on four vertices.
title: Directed-cut shattering and comparison queries on one-descent permutations
